topic: Electrical load determination and various load protection techniques
syllabus_extract: Electrical load determination and various load protection techniques.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of wiring diagrams and identification of load protection devices; Safety: Ensure no live circuits are touched; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of aircraft wiring?
List three common causes of wiring degradation.
Why is load determination critical for aircraft safety?

topics: Impact of degradation on system integrity
development.content:
Aircraft wiring system overview
Conductor materials and insulation types
Causes of wiring degradation
Impact of degradation on system integrity

Methods for electrical load determination
Calculation of total circuit load
Identification of overload conditions
Consequences of improper load management

Overview of load protection techniques
Fuses and their operating principles
Circuit breakers and reset mechanisms

summary_questions: Explain how wiring degradation leads to electrical failure.
Describe the difference between a fuse and a circuit breaker in load protection.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the specific load protection devices discussed in this lesson to be reviewed in the next lesson on circuit breakers.

pft_rows.syllabus: Introduction to circuit breakers and various protection provided by circuit breakers.
